publication.label: The Nightmare · 1v1 Rankings
publication.description: Fictional sample data for reviewing a Dead by Daylight symmetric 1v1 leaderboard. All included duels use The Nightmare.

competition.label: Dead by Daylight · Symmetric 1v1
competition.description: Two players use the same killer character and each plays both killer and survivor. Each round goes to the player with the longer chase; the first to win two rounds wins the duel.

category.label: Killer
category.description: Killer character used by both players in every included duel.

value.label: The Nightmare
value.description: Both players use The Nightmare when playing killer.

methodology_description: Ranking scores describe current-season competitive performance among players eligible when this snapshot is generated. Entry ratings determine eligibility and do not directly contribute to ranking scores. In this illustrative publication, all encounters between the same unordered pair of players share a total calculation weight capped at one match-equivalent, divided equally among their encounters regardless of seat. Every encounter remains in match totals and evidence. Scores are hand-authored for this fictional preview, not calculated by a ranking model.

boards.label: Player rankings
boards.description: Eligible players competing in symmetric 1v1 duels with The Nightmare this season.

score_definition.label: Ranking score
score_definition.description: Illustrative integer points: higher scores rank ahead within this board, and equal scores share a rank. Points are not a win percentage or an entry rating. Compare scores only within this snapshot; no comparison across killers, seasons, or refreshes is supported.

rating.label: The Nightmare entry rating
rating.description: Entry rating specific to The Nightmare in symmetric 1v1. This fictional preview uses a 0–3000 point scale where higher values indicate stronger performance. Individual entry ratings are not published.

eligibility.description: At generation time, players need a Nightmare entry rating of at least 1200 points and at least three current-season duels against players in the calculation-time eligible pool. Repeat encounters count toward participation. Eligibility is reevaluated on every refresh, even without new matches. These thresholds are illustrative.

result_metrics.label: Wins
result_metrics.description: Included duels where this player occupied the winning seat.

result_metrics.label: Losses
result_metrics.description: Included duels where this player occupied the other seat. Every duel has one winner and one loser.

public_outcomes.label: Decided
public_outcomes.description: The best-of-three duel was decided. public_facts.winner_side_id identifies the winning seat and its player.

side_definitions.label: Player 1
side_definitions.description: First neutral seat in this duel. It implies no advantage or role order and does not follow a player across matches.

side_definitions.label: Player 2
side_definitions.description: Second neutral seat in this duel. It implies no advantage or role order and does not follow a player across matches.

public_facts_schema.description: Winning seat and rounds won by each seat in a best-of-three symmetric 1v1 duel. The killer character is supplied by the publication scope.
